items.html: However, after ZA has already grown in the male and female sides within him, then the mochin depart, and the mochin of Bina and Gevura of Aba and Ima come alone within the Nukva, and she grows completely. And behold, all these mochin, called the aspect of back to back, are completed; and afterward the new mochin of face to face come, and they enlarge both of them as at first.
